hook: Families without ration cards may get the *Rs 5 lakh* Indiramma cover via Aadhaar
hook_b: Families without ration cards may get the *Rs 5 lakh* Indiramma cover via Aadhaar
tldr: Officials are exploring Aadhaar-based enrolment for Indiramma Kutumba Jeevitha Bima for households without ration cards; guidelines are pending.

beats.what: Officials are considering Aadhaar-based enrolment for families without ration cards in a later phase; one proposal excludes income-tax payers.
beats.why: The scheme, launched on Nov 19, enrols through ration card details; about 3 lakh families have joined so far.
beats.care: It gives Rs 5 lakh life cover to one member aged 18-59 per household, with the government paying the premium.

causes.label: Scheme enrols only via ration cards

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Guidelines from Nov 21 let families with ration cards from other districts enrol at the nearest camp.

cards.q: Aadhaar-based enrolment for families without ration cards: good idea?

qs: How will officials verify income for families without ration cards?
Will Rythu Bima holders need to re-enrol?

facts.t: Telangana has about *1.15 crore* families; nearly 40 lakh are already under govt insurance or welfare schemes.

viz.l: Telangana families already covered by govt insurance or welfare schemes
viz.verdict: Most families are not yet in a govt insurance scheme; the new cover aims to fill that gap.

learn.t: e-KYC = online identity check; pending ration card e-KYC must be done at PDS shops before enrolling

watch: Fresh instructions on eligibility and exceptional cases are expected shortly, officials said.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Indiramma insurance: Telangana weighs Aadhaar-based cover for families without ration cards

fact: Telangana may open its *Rs 5 lakh* Indiramma cover to families without ration cards
twist: Around *3 lakh* families have household heads living abroad, and enrolment rules for them are undecided.
